implemented_boundaries.hot_path_intent: The low-reasoning semantic planner evaluates every natural turn; a literal question-mark rule no longer decides whether Eva can understand an implicit memory reference.
implemented_boundaries.temporal_authority: A bounded Hindsight source-fact envelope restores the original authority behind an observation. The model sees retrieval rank, observed_at and trust and must select the newest reliable value when one concrete property conflicts.
implemented_boundaries.durable_enqueue: The direct user source is committed to a separate PostgreSQL outbox thread before the in-process worker is woken.
implemented_boundaries.crash_rehydration: Worker startup and its bounded idle poll load active, failed and ambiguous memory checkpoints from PostgreSQL and resubmit the deterministic Hindsight document operation.
implemented_boundaries.retry_boundary: Each provider attempt is committed before HTTP contact. Retry count is database-enforced within 0..3; attempt three becomes needs_help instead of looping forever.
implemented_boundaries.provider_idempotency: Hindsight uses update_mode replace and a UUIDv5 operation ID derived from document_id.
implemented_boundaries.principal_isolation: Advanced-task context scopes on requested_by before strict decoding, so another principal's legacy or malformed plan cannot break or leak into this conversation.

hard_crash_recovery_on_current_image.fault: With the current image stopped, a durable outbox document was inserted. Hindsight was paused, the current core started, then was hard-killed after MEMORY_RETAIN_ATTEMPTED and before provider acknowledgement. Hindsight was unpaused and the same current core container restarted.
